horizontal_magnet_raw54.scope: 훈14: RIGHT 20 ticks then release. Original handler adds +40/tick capped at 3000 to per-player accumulator and sets direction 5; held direction keeps accumulator at 40, release produces growing rightward displacement. 79/106 samples were exact full-core boundaries, 20 were adjacent torn reads, and 7 were identified intra-tick accumulator/direction write windows; coherent mismatch 0. Original 0x41e510-built LMF matched the captured world for all 121 tested boundaries and all 108 initial object records byte-for-byte.

horizontal_magnet_raw55.scope: 훈15 mirrored fixture: LEFT 20 ticks then release. Normal Client and original-x86-built world agree on direction 2, +40 contact accumulation, and leftward release; 78/113 exact boundaries, 31 adjacent torn reads, 4 intra-tick write windows, coherent mismatch 0.

vertical_magnet_raw53.scope: 훈16: align at x336 and jump. Field sets player +0xD8=2 and changes vertical acceleration from -40 to -20 per tick while in range. 132/143 live samples were exact selected-field boundaries; remaining samples were torn or known D8/jump/input-edge write windows; coherent mismatch 0. Original 0x41e510-built world matched captured world for 199 boundaries and 34/34 initial object records byte-for-byte.

vertical_magnet_raw52.scope: 훈17 RIGHT+UP then RIGHT crossing: field sets player +0xD8=1 and changes vertical acceleration to -100 per tick, leading to the same fall/reset path. 88/97 in-fixture live samples were exact selected-field boundaries; remaining samples were torn or known D8/jump write windows; coherent mismatch 0. Original 0x41e510-built world matched captured world for 154 boundaries and 33/33 initial object records byte-for-byte.

triangular_ice_raw27.scope: 훈18 LEFT+DOWN 21 ticks then release: slope contact stores +40/tick in per-player 0x25CA528, direction 2 in 0x25CA078, reaches 400, continues left without input, decays by 10/tick after leaving the slope, and clears on exhaustion/locomotion boundary. 94/113 normal samples were exact selected-field boundaries and 19 adjacent torn reads; coherent mismatch 0. Original-built map after 21 spawn-settle ticks matched 142 route boundaries, 62/62 initial objects, and all four collision grids byte-for-byte.

triangular_ice_raw37.scope: 훈19 RIGHT+DOWN 21 ticks then release: mirrored slope contact stores +40/tick in 0x25CA528, direction 5 in 0x25CA078, reaches 400, continues right after release, and decays by 10/tick. 82/109 normal samples were exact selected-field boundaries, 26 were adjacent torn reads, and 1 was the identified input-update window; coherent mismatch 0. The original-built map plus the measured loader collision-mask pass, after 35 spawn-settle ticks, matched 142 route boundaries, 68/68 initial objects, and all four grids byte-for-byte.

disappearing_block_raw124.scope: 훈20 raw124 proximity disappearing block. When the player is within the original handler's contact window, object +0xC8 rises by 20/tick to 255 and collision grid code 1 clears; away from it, +0xC8 falls by 2/tick to 0 and the block becomes solid again. The full player/block cycle is 143 ticks in this fixture. Normal Client sampling observed all 143 cycle boundaries: 248/346 samples were exact, 97 adjacent torn reads, 1 identified respawn write window, coherent mismatch 0. After phase alignment, the original-built LMF matched all 143 boundaries, all 32 object records, and all four grids byte-for-byte.

client_tick_clock.scope: Current 훈1 read-only Client trace: 240px held-RIGHT movement covered 59 tick intervals in 944.825ms (62.445Hz). Oracle wall pacing is 62.5Hz and emulated timeGetTime advances 16ms/tick. Existing paired 훈2 RIGHT fixture remains 13/13 exact boundaries.

fire_then_spike_protection.scope: User says a fire-hit/knocked-down player touching spikes must not be hit again until recovery. Synthetic original-x86 raw48 -> raw86 regression enters state38=5,+0x7c=12 and preserves that code for all 16 spike-contact ticks. Normal Client same-boundary trace remains optional follow-up.

raw51_identity.scope: The grey floor device in 낙라 is raw51/runtime type 0x10e. Original handler checks parachute +0xdc==1, overlap, then writes +0xdc=2; it has no damage call. Damage bomb raw87/raw88 is a separate family.
